title: Ritch's later loan and the Club Harlem Orchestra name
summary: In 1935 Ritch lent Carter fare to return to Paris after the kidnapping case; the club gave the band its name.

bands.name: Benny Carter and the Club Harlem Orchestra

story.theme_name: Going abroad: American jazz musicians touring and living in Europe
story.community_name: Going abroad: touring Europe and Japan

blocks.x: And I might also add that in 1935, when I had to go to Europe, after I had been brought back, well, I was forced to come back --that's hard to say -- that I was forced, even; I voluntarily came back to avoid a lot of difficulty because I had taken my daughter with me, and ...
And my daughter's mother had said that her child had been kidnapped, you know.
And naturally, I came back -- and after all of the litigation, I was pretty broke, and George loaned me $150 to go back to -- you know, to pay my fare back to Paris to join Willie Lewis's band again.
So all of this is still back in early '33?
Oh yes, 1933 -- except that George Rich lent me $150 to go to ...
Maybe we can get back to that later on.
Yeah, okay, we'll get up to that, sure.
The orchestra that he -- for which he buys this club, when is that - that's about '33 still?
So it's still at a time when ...
Because that's how I came by the name of Benny Carter and the Club Harlem Orchestra.
Right. And that goes back to what we were talking about, around the time that you bring Teddy from Chicago? That orchestra?
The time when that orchestra is billed with Bessie Smith, which was something that didn't ...
